The user says "I need to arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking number 1234, and want to check different options." So maybe they want to see cost before booking. We can just compute cost. But do we need to also consider insurance? Not specified. Just cost. So we call get_flight_cost. Then respond with cost. Also mention that we can proceed to book if desired. No need to call book_flight yet. So let's call get_flight_cost.
